about_the_game:
This is a top-down 2D tank action game.

Players control a tank, called a "TANK," and defeat enemy TANKs by charging and firing to clear missions.

A TANK is mainly composed of a body, turret, shield, caterpillar tracks, and bullets, and can also be equipped with optional parts called modules and gadgets. Players can freely customize their TANKs and set off on missions.

There are three main types of bullets, and players can switch between them during missions.

Charge type

Equipped with a "ricochet" function that reflects bullets when they hit a wall, allowing you to target enemy TANKs from blind spots.

Rapid type

Fires small bullets in rapid succession, dealing large damage with a concentrated attack on one point.

Blade type

Firing a blade from the turret, slashing the opponent repeatedly.

The appeal of this game is that you can freely build tactics based on the battle situation, terrain, and your own equipment, and win.
